query.commandtext: -- Create Date : 2014-01-28 13:48:49 INSERT INTO TQC_SECURITY_GROUP_HISTORY(SEC_GRP_SEQ, SEC_GRP_ID, SEC_GRP_DESC, REMARK, TRAN_TIME, USER_CMF_1, USER_CMF_2, USER_CMF_3, USER_CMF_4, USER_CMF_5) VALUES(SEC_GRP_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :strSecGrpId, :strSecGrpDesc, :strRemark, :strTrantime,:strUserCmf1, :strUserCmf2, :strUserCmf3, :strUserCmf4, :strUserCmf5)

-- Create Date : 2014-01-28 13:53:44 SELECT USER_CMF_1 AS STATUS ,SEC_GRP_SEQ, SEC_GRP_ID, SEC_GRP_DESC, REMARK, TRAN_TIME FROM TQC_SECURITY_GROUP_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:st_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC

-- Create Date : 2014-01-28 13:58:19 SELECT USER_CMF_1 AS STATUS ,SEC_GRP_SEQ, SEC_GRP_ID, SEC_GRP_DESC, REMARK, TRAN_TIME FROM TQC_SECURITY_GROUP_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:st_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND SEC_GRP_DESC = :strSecGrpName ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC

-- Create Date : 2014-01-28 13:58:47 SELECT USER_CMF_1 AS STATUS ,SEC_GRP_SEQ, SEC_GRP_ID, SEC_GRP_DESC, REMARK, TRAN_TIME FROM TQC_SECURITY_GROUP_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:st_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND USER_CMF_1 = 'Delete' ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC, SEC_GRP_ID ASC
